newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Fondiaria names Gavazzi to board.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Fondiaria names Gavazzi to board.

text.p: Italian insurer Fondiaria confirmed it had appointed Roberto Gavazzi to the board taking the place of Amato Luigi Molinari, Molinari said at a shareholders meeting on Friday.
Fondiaria shares have risen in recent days on speculation that Gavazzi, who was a board member at German insurer Allianz, would join the Italian insurance company's board.
Fondiaria shares were up around 0.7 percent at 6,845 lire by 1225 GMT.
Molinari, who is managing director of Fondiaria, is leaving the board.
Gavazzi was head of European operations at Allianz.

Fondiaria also said in a report to the shareholders' meeting that its Italian insurance premiums rose around 10 percent in the first four months of 1997, with life premiums up 21 percent and non-life premiums up 7.8 percent.
